mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}

SELECT HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(bucket_epoch)) as hour, COUNT(*) as requestCount, bucket_epoch * 1000 as timestamp FROM ( SELECT FLOOR((request_time + #{bucketOffsetSeconds}) / 3600) * 3600 - #{bucketOffsetSeconds} as bucket_epoch FROM request_logs WHERE request_time >= #{startEpochSecond} AND request_time < #{endEpochSecond} ) traffic_logs GROUP BY bucket_epoch ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', bucket_epoch, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) as hour, COUNT(*) as requestCount, bucket_epoch * 1000 as timestamp FROM ( SELECT CAST(((request_time + #{bucketOffsetSeconds}) / 3600) AS INTEGER) * 3600 - #{bucketOffsetSeconds} as bucket_epoch FROM request_logs WHERE request_time >= #{startEpochSecond} AND request_time < #{endEpochSecond} ) traffic_logs GROUP BY bucket_epoch ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT actual_model_name as modelName, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COUNT(*) as requestCount FROM request_logs WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND actual_model_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actual_model_name ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT actual_model_name as modelName, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, COUNT(*) as requestCount FROM request_logs WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND actual_model_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actual_model_name ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT provider_id as providerId, provider_name as providerName, COUNT(*) as callCount, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as estimatedCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name ORDER BY callCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT provider_id as providerId, provider_name as providerName, COUNT(*) as callCount, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) as estimatedCost, COALESCE(AVG(total_time_ms), 0) as avgLatency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) as successRate FROM request_logs GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name ORDER BY callCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(FLOOR(log_epoch / 900) * 900 AS UNSIGNED) as bucket_start_epoch, COUNT(*) as total_requests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as success_requests FROM ( SELECT request_time as log_epoch, status FROM request_logs WHERE request_time >= #{startEpochSecond} AND request_time < #{endEpochSecond} AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') UNION ALL SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) as log_epoch, status FROM request_logs WHERE request_time IS NULL AND created_at >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startEpochSecond}) AND created_at < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endEpochSecond}) AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') ) heatmap_logs GROUP BY bucket_start_epoch ORDER BY bucket_start_epoch

SELECT CAST((log_epoch / 900) AS INTEGER) * 900 as bucket_start_epoch, COUNT(*) as total_requests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as success_requests FROM ( SELECT request_time as log_epoch, status FROM request_logs WHERE request_time >= #{startEpochSecond} AND request_time < #{endEpochSecond} AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') UNION ALL SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) AS INTEGER) as log_epoch, status FROM request_logs WHERE request_time IS NULL AND created_at >= datetime(#{startEpochSecond}, 'unixepoch') AND created_at < datetime(#{endEpochSecond}, 'unixepoch') AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') ) heatmap_logs GROUP BY bucket_start_epoch ORDER BY bucket_start_epoch
